basic_details.job_title: Secunderabad Cantonment Board Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for Additional Legal Counsel and Full time Legal Assistant Posts
basic_details.short_information: Secunderabad Cantonment Board is recruiting candidates for Additional Legal Counsel and Full time Legal Assistant posts. Applications for these positions can be sent by email or submitted to the Office of the Secunderabad Cantonment Board on or before 26 October 2026, starting from 5 October 2026 under advertisement number SCB/Legal Cell/1808. Eligibility requires a Bachelor's Degree in Law from a recognized university and Bar Council enrolment, with Full time Legal Assistant requiring at least 05 years experience. content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Interested candidates are required to submit their applications along with certificates separately (for the engagement of Additional Legal Counsel and fulltime Legal Assistant) in respect of their educational qualification and experience in working as a counsel in any Government organization. Applications can be submitted to the Office of the Secunderabad Cantonment Board, S.P Road, Court Compound, Secunderabad or emailed to [email protected] on or before 26-10-2026. Application forms can be downloaded from https://secunderabad.cantt.gov.in/.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Additional Legal Counsel Eligibility: Must possess a Bachelor’s Degree in Law from a recognized university and must have Bar Council enrolment with experience in dealing and handling of cases in Government Offices under various Rules, Acts and Regulations. Applicants having knowledge on Cantonment Laws and Rules/ Dealing with Defence land cases within Cantonment area would be given preference. Full time Legal Assistant Eligibility: Must possess a Bachelor’s degree in Law from a recognized university and must have Bar Council enrolment with at least 05 years experience of working independently and handling cases of government organizations.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to submit applications for Secunderabad Cantonment Board Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications is 26-10-2026.

faq.question: Q2. Where should the applications be sent or submitted?
faq.answer: Applications can be submitted to the Office of the Secunderabad Cantonment Board, S.P Road, Court Compound, Secunderabad or emailed to [email protected].

faq.question: Q3. What educational qualification is required for these posts?
faq.answer: Applicants must possess a Bachelor’s Degree in Law from a recognized university and must have Bar Council enrolment.

faq.question: Q4. Is prior experience required for the Full time Legal Assistant post?
faq.answer: Yes, the applicant must have at least 05 years of experience working independently and handling cases of government organizations.

faq.question: Q5. What preference is given for the Additional Legal Counsel position?
faq.answer: Applicants having knowledge of Cantonment Laws and Rules or experience in dealing with Defence land cases within the Cantonment area will be given preference.
